sites.evidence_type: N-terminal HA epitope; parallel surface-display screen
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface immunostaining PME 4314.2 ± 329.4 (HA immunostaining, Tedman deep receptor scanning)
sites.rationale: Experimentally validated N-terminal HA epitope insertion (after signal-peptide cleavage where present); surface expression read out by HA immunostaining in Tedman et al. deep receptor scanning.

sources.citation: Tedman et al., Efficient experimental characterization of the GPCRome via deep receptor scanning, Nat Commun 2026 (bioRxiv 2025.09.19.677468, PMC12458215)
sources.claim: N-terminal HA epitope inserted per receptor; surface expression read out by HA immunostaining in a pooled GPCRome deep-receptor-scanning screen.

sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface expression confirmed by anti-HA antibody staining of intact CHO-K1 cells (L3); ligand-binding or signalling function of the HA-tagged wild-type receptor was NOT MEASURED as a separate endpoint in the cited papers (the functional study in PMC5704194 focuses on the D196G mutant).
sites.rationale: The PCR primer sequence in L2 unambiguously encodes Met-1 followed by the full HA nonapeptide (YPYDVPDYA) followed by Ser-2 of the native sequence, placing the junction at insert_after_residue=1. LTB4R2 is a GPCR with no signal peptide; the N-terminus (residues 1–22) is directly extracellular per the authoritative topology landmarks, so the tag sits on the cell surface. L3 independently confirms surface display by anti-HA staining of intact CHO-K1 cells expressing this construct. The insertion point is 22 residues from the TM1 boundary (residue 23), well above the ≥3-residue minimum. Full-length human BLT2 (LTB4R2) HA-tagged construct expressed in CHO-K1 cells. The sense primer for the HA construct (L2) encodes ATG [Met-1] then TACCCCTACGACGTGCCCGACTACGCC [HA = YPYDVPDYA] then TCGGTCTGCTACCGT [= Ser-2 Val-3 Cys-4 Tyr-5 Arg-6 of native sequence], placing the tag between residue 1 (M) and residue 2 (S). Surface expression confirmed by anti-HA antibody staining (L3).

sources.claim: The inserts were amplified from the genomic clone containing a full-length BLT2 by PCR with sense (5′-CGGGATCCCGCCATGTCGGTCTGCTACCGT-3′ and 5′-CGGGATCCCGCCATGTACCCCTACGACGTGCCCGACTACGCCTCGGTCTGCTACCGTCC-3′ for wild-type and HA, respectively) and antisense (5′-GGAATTCAAAGGTCCCATTCCGG-3′) primers, digested with BamHI and EcoRI, and subcloned into pcDNA3 vector (Invitrogen).

literature_notes: All three ledger lines (L1, L2, L3) describe the same N-terminal HA-tagged hBLT2 construct; L2 provides the definitive residue-level evidence via the primer sequence. No other insertion sites appear anywhere in the ledger. The four internal extracellular loops (ECL1: 81–95, ECL2: 160–178, ECL3: 250–271) are not supported by any ledger line and are therefore not proposed. No intracellular or function-abrogating positions are named in the ledger.
